title: Cannot wait for @Damn Yankees Broadway ⚾️🔥. Thanks so much @relayinfl...
transcript: Come with me to a very rainy Yankees game to celebrate the announcement that Damn Yankees is coming back to Broadway. Now, the game was supposed to start at 1 PM, but we had a rain delay. But we were in a suite, so I was so unbothered. I go to baseball games more for the stadium experience than the actual game itself, so I was happy to just enjoy the food and the company. But we did get to go down to the actual Yankees press room, where they hosted a little press conference with the cast and director. So we got to hear from Neil Patrick Harris, Julianne Hough, Austin Scott, and director Sergio Truijillo about this brand new, reimagined production of Damn Yankees that is coming to Broadway this spring. The Yankees is a score that I have loved for a while, but I've never gotten to see a full production of it. And you could tell listening to the cast, that they all have such a reverence for this material. And I'd heard great things about this revised script from when it played D C. Last year. So very excited to see it on Broadway. We then went back to the suite, where, sadly, we found out that the game had been cancelled. But I still walked away with a full belly and a free T-shirt. So really, who can complain?
classificationReason: Creator attended a press conference/announcement event at a Yankees game celebrating the Damn Yankees Broadway revival announcement. Shares excitement and previews the cast, but has not seen the production. This is anticipation/commentary, not a review. 'Damn Yankees' is not on the provided show list.
